definition.en: Ankylosaurus is bounded here by Carpenter’s redescription of referred Upper Cretaceous western North American material; the revised diagnosis does not make every isolated ankylosaurid remain part of the genus or define exact global endpoints. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 甲龙属在此由 Carpenter 对北美西部上白垩统归入材料的再描述限定；修订诊断不把每件孤立甲龙科遗骸都纳入该属，也不定义精确全球端点。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Redescription of Ankylosaurus magniventris Brown 1908 (Ankylosauridae) from the Upper Cretaceous of the Western Interior of North America directly anchors the sampled window; the display does not extrapolate it into a global taxon duration.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Ceratopsia is represented by a sampled morphology matrix in which the Aquilops holotype is placed among early neoceratopsians; that placement and its biogeographic implications do not identify a direct ancestor or a clade-wide first appearance. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 角龙类由一个取样形态矩阵表示，其中 Aquilops 正模被置于早期新角龙类；该位置及其生物地理含义不识别直接祖先或全支系首现。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: A Ceratopsian Dinosaur from the Lower Cretaceous of Western North America, and the Biogeography of Neoceratopsia directly anchors the sampled window; the display does not extrapolate it into a global taxon duration.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Triceratops remains a separately diagnosed genus in Longrich and Field’s sampled ontogenetic comparison with Torosaurus; the result is one side of an active taxonomic hypothesis and does not determine the genus’s complete range. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 在 Longrich 与 Field 对三角龙和牛角龙的取样个体发育比较中，三角龙仍是独立诊断属；该结果是持续分类争论的一种假说，不决定该属完整范围。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: Torosaurus Is Not Triceratops: Ontogeny in Chasmosaurine Ceratopsids as a Case Study in Dinosaur Taxonomy directly anchors the sampled window; the display does not extrapolate it into a global taxon duration.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Yinlong downsi is based on holotype IVPP V14530, and the study recovers the taxon as a basal ceratopsian in its sampled character matrix; that analysis is not evidence of an uncontested relationship or direct ancestry. temporalRange.basis: Primary-study specimen, formation or explicitly bounded dossier evidence.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Hadrosauridae is displayed at 100.5–66 Ma only as the source's global historical-biogeography sample, not an exhaustive family record or exact endpoints. definition.zh: Hadrosauridae 仅以 100.5–66 Ma 展示为论文历史生物地理分析所采样的全球记录，而非穷尽的科级记录或精确端点。该区间是来源限定的样本窗口，不是全球首现、末现、分化日期、连续占据或直接祖先断言。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

definition.en: Edmontosaurus is bounded by Campione and Evans’s cranial growth and variation sample, which supports a reduced latest-Cretaceous North American species set; the morphometric result does not assign every hadrosaurid skull or define exact genus endpoints. definition.en: The 150–0 Ma Aves route is an avialan-to-living-bird navigation anthology: referred Archaeopteryx material supplies a Late Jurassic fossil anchor, but Archaeopteryx is outside crown Neornithes and the endpoint is not crown-Aves origination. limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Archaeopteryx is a Late Jurassic avialan outside crown Neornithes; substantial anatomical variation among referred specimens does not make it the direct ancestor of living birds. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: Archaeopteryx 是位于冠群今鸟类之外的晚侏罗世鸟翼类；归入标本间的显著解剖变异也不使它成为现生鸟类的直系祖先。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Neornithes is the crown defined by the common ancestor of living birds and all descendants; Archaeopteryx is outside that crown, while Vegavis and Asteriornis require explicit fossil-placement analyses. This navigation entry is not a phylogeny or a complete taxon dossier.
definition.zh: 今鸟类是由所有现生鸟类最近共同祖先及其全部后代定义的冠群；Archaeopteryx 位于该冠群之外，而 Vegavis 与 Asteriornis 必须依赖明确的化石位置分析。 此导航摘要不表示系统发育或完整的类群档案。

temporalRange.basis: AMNH FARB 30899 is from a 69.2–68.4 Ma interval and the combined analysis supports waterfowl affinity; earlier conflicting placements remain explicit, while Asteriornis supplies a younger independent crown test.

limitations: A missing branch or fossil occurrence does not imply biological absence. Internal nodes are not calibrated divergence estimates.

definition.en: Phorusrhacidae is represented by the named Llallawavis specimen and its morphology-matrix placement within terror birds; sensory reconstructions and family relationships are study hypotheses, not a complete range or ancestor chain. definition.en: Field et al. named Asteriornis maastrichtensis from holotype NHMM 2013 008; parsimony placed it as sister to crown Galloanserae whereas tip-dated Bayesian analysis placed it as the stemward-most Pangalliformes member, so exact crown position remains method-dependent.
